quotes: In July 2026, the Company cleared 10,180 MW in the PJM BRA for the 2028/2029 PJM Capacity Year at a price of $325.00/MWd.

financial_health.basis: Risk wording stated; the posted amount is stated in the cash flow statement.

quotes: Because we are required to collateralize hedges that settle in future delivery periods, but do not receive settlements for electric generation until delivery, collateral requirements could result in periods of lower available liquidity.

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the 10-Q MD&A and the earnings release, which attribute the volume and revenue increases to the acquisitions.

quotes: Adjusted EBITDA increased by $306 million primarily due to the contribution of acquired generation facilities, higher settled power prices and generation volumes (net of realized hedges), and higher capacity revenues.

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the balance sheet, income statement and earnings release; the link between debt and growth is inferred.

quotes: Such amounts were outweighed by unrealized mark-to-market losses on commodity derivative contracts and an increase in interest expense associated with acquisition financings.

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the 10-Q MD&A and statements; the continuation condition is inferred.

quotes: In July 2026, the Company cleared 10,180 MW in the PJM BRA for the 2028/2029 PJM Capacity Year at a price of $325.00/MWd.

growth_thesis.basis: Prices are stated in the 10-Q. The demand condition is stated in the 10-K and its risk factors.

Forward Q4 baseload prices were $71.54 against $47.50. This continues only if the demand growth the company cites materializes.
quotes: Power demand forecasts continue to rise over time in PJM compared to previous expectations.

Expected demand growth from the technology sector, manufacturing, and other uses of electricity, which has driven recent improvements in the outlook for the competitive wholesale power generation market, may not actually occur or be sustained.

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the 10-K Business section and risk factors; the 10-K is dated before the 2026 transition milestones.

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the 8-K; the upside trade-off is inferred.

growth_thesis.claim: Management guides to further growth in 2027, with Adjusted EBITDA of $2,500 million - $2,850 million, about 26% above the 2026 midpoint.
